title: Omotola's Chest Key

sources.title: The Glitter Gala
markers: Its copy lies on the top of the display case

summary: Unlocks the chest behind Omotola’s counter in the Glitter Gala.

fields.Lock: The locked chest behind the counter. The item page calls it a Gilded Chest; the location calls it opulent.
fields.Acquisition: DC 15 Perception reveals a copy near the plant at X −176, Y −66. Another copy is behind the counter. Sources disagree on the exact placement of that copy.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
